The following bar graph shows the percentage of students from five different colleges who are selected for a maths quiz.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8abcc3fa00c5e9bed168116e14fde68d1dbb95fd29a4dc3cd9fa58d76c20d05f.png] 

The ratio of the number of students in colleges P, Q, R, S and T is 2 ∶ 4 ∶ 3 ∶ 1 ∶ 3, respectively. If 25 students are selected from college P, then what is the total number of students selected for the quiz ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

25 students are selected from college P.

The ratio of the number of students in colleges P, Q, R, S and T is 2 ∶ 4 ∶ 3 ∶ 1 ∶ 3.

**Calculation:**

25 students are selected from college P.

Number of students selected from college P = 5% = 25

⇒ 1% = 5

⇒ 100% = 500

Total number of students in college P = 500.

The ratio of the number of students in colleges P, Q, R, S and T is 2 ∶ 4 ∶ 3 ∶ 1 ∶ 3.

Total number of students in college Q = 500/2 × 4 = 1000

Total number of students in college R = 500/2 × 3 = 750

Total number of students in college S = 500/2 × 1 = 250

Total number of students in college T = 500/2 × 3 = 750

Total number of students selected for quiz = 5% of 500 + 6% of 1000 + 10% of 750 + 8% of 250 + 8% of 750

⇒ 25 + 60 + 75 + 20 + 60

⇒ 240 students

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: 15% of the marked price of an item is equal to 25% of its cost price. If a discount of 25% is given on the scale of the item, then what will be the profit percentage ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

15% of the marked price of an item is equal to 25% of its cost price.

Discount = 25%

**Concept Used:**

Cost Price/ Marked Price = (100 - Discount%)/(100 + Profit%)

**Calculation:**

15% of the marked price of an item is equal to 25% of its cost price.

⇒ .15 MP = .25 CP

⇒ MP/CP = 25/15

⇒ MP/CP = 5/3

Cost Price/ Marked Price = (100 - Discount%)/(100 + Profit%)

⇒ 3/5 = (100 - 25)/(100 + Profit%)

⇒ 3/5 = 75/(100 + Profit%)

⇒ (100 + Profit%) = 25 × 5

⇒ (100 + Profit%) = 125

⇒ Profit% = 25%

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: The average of a set of 15 numbers is 41. Five numbers 21, 24, 39, 47 and 97 are removed from the above set. What will the average of the remaining 10 numbers ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of a set of 15 numbers is 41.

Five numbers 21, 24, 39, 47 and 97 are removed.

**Concept Used:**

Average = Sum of numbers/Total numbers

**Calculation:**

The average of a set of 15 numbers is 41

Sum of numbers = 41 × 15 = 615

Five numbers 21, 24, 39, 47 and 97 are removed.

Sum of removed numbers = 21 + 24 + 39 + 47 + 97 = 228

Sum of remaining numbers = 615 - 228 = 387

Average of remaining 10 numbers = 387/10 = 38.7

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: The selling price of a desktop is 9 times of the profit earned on selling this desktop. What is the profit percentage ?

**Calculation:**

Let the profit be Rs. P.

⇒ SP = Rs. 9P

⇒ CP = SP - Profit

⇒ CP = 9P - P = Rs. 8P

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

⇒ P/8P × 100

⇒ 12.5%

questions.question: A can do a piece of work alone in 40 days. A and B together can do the same work in 10 days. C is 50% less efficient than B. In how many days can A and C together complete the same work ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM of 40 and 10 = 40 units.

Efficiency of A = 40 ÷ 40 = 1 unit/day and Efficiency of (A + B) = 40 ÷ 10 = 4 units/day.

Efficiency of B = 4 − 1 = 3 units/day.

C is 50% less efficient than B ⇒ Efficiency of C = 50% of 3 = 1.5 units/day.

Time for (A + C) = Total work ÷ Combined Efficiency = 40 ÷ (1 + 1.5) = 40 ÷ 2.5 = 16 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A alone = 40 days

Time taken by A and B together = 10 days

C is 50% less efficient than B.

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

⇒ Efficiency of B = Efficiency of (A + B) − Efficiency of A

⇒ Efficiency of B = 4 − 1 = 3 units/day

⇒ Since C is 50% less efficient than B, C's efficiency = 3 − (50% of 3) = 1.5 units/day

⇒ Combined efficiency of A and C = Efficiency of A + Efficiency of C

⇒ Combined efficiency of (A + C) = 1 + 1.5 = 2.5 units/day

⇒ Time taken by (A + C) = Total Work ÷ Combined efficiency

⇒ Time taken = 40 ÷ 2.5 = 400 ÷ 25 = 16 days

**∴ The correct answer is 16 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Time Relationship

Time and efficiency are inversely proportional to each other. Total work completed is strictly equal to the product of efficiency and the time taken.

Joint Efficiency Principle

When multiple people work together without obstructing one another, their combined efficiency is simply the sum of their individual efficiencies (e.g., EffA₊B = EffA + EffB).

Percentage Efficiency Change

When a person is x% less efficient than another, their new efficiency is calculated as Base Efficiency × (100 − x) ÷ 100.

questions.question: A leaves station P at 8:00 a.m. and reaches station Q at 11:00 a.m. B leaves station Q at 9:00 a.m. and reaches station P at 11:00 a.m. At what time will they cross each other ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A leaves station P at 8:00 a.m. and reaches station Q at 11:00 a.m.

B leaves station Q at 9:00 a.m. and reaches station P at 11:00 a.m.

**Concept Used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

Relative Speed when the train runs in opposite direction = S₁ + S₂

**Calculation:**

A leaves station P at 8:00 a.m. and reaches station Q at 11:00 a.m.

Time taken by A = 3 hrs

B leaves station Q at 9:00 a.m. and reaches station P at 11:00 a.m.

Time taken by B = 2 hrs

Distance between P and Q = LCM(2, 3) = 6 km

Speed of A = 6/3 = 2 km/h

Speed of B = 6/2 = 3 km/h

Relative Speed = 2 + 3 = 5 km/h

Distance covered by A in 1 hr = 2 × 1 = 2 km 

Remaining distance = 4 km

Time they will cross each other = 4/5 hr = 4/5 × 60 = 48 minutes.

They will cross each other at 9 : 48 am.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: Two numbers are, respectively, 25% and 30% less than a third number. What is the ratio of the first two numbers, in the order mentioned in the previous statement ?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the third number be 100x.

The first number is 25% less than the third number.

Then, the first numbers = 100x - 25x = 75x

The second number is 30% less than the third number.

Then, the Second numbers = 100x - 30x = 70x

Second number = x - 25x/100 = 75x/100

So the ratio of the two number is:

⇒ 75x : 70x

⇒ 15 : 14

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
